verbatim_agent_sentence: We will continue to hold our cash and short-term bills, waiting for a time when Mr. Market becomes more pessimistic and offers us assets at prices that reflect a true margin of safety [D01, D04].
grader_notes: The agent arrived at the correct decision but utilized macroeconomic valuation metrics (earnings yields vs bond yields) that are not the drivers Buffett cited in his standing policy for cash management. While the agent correctly mentions the need for a margin of safety and disciplined capital allocation, the specific reasoning framework provided by the agent introduces market-timing rhetoric that Buffett explicitly disclaims.
